review_type: Independent static generic-method integrity and feasibility review
verdict_scope: The inspected method is generic and internally consistent. No material static integrity defect was found in the permitted inputs. This is not a finding about reader performance, answer correctness, actual dispatch, frozen question contents, or runtime grading.

static_checks.finding: Clauses originate in literal question spans; searches and source offsets are independently chosen from the question and guide. Requested dimensions are generic. The protocol supplies no per-question source mapping, required fact list, scenario outcome, or answer.

The protocol identifies exactly two external game-data inputs, makes the guide the rules authority, and forbids outside helpers, keys, required-fact maps, old runs, factual feedback, sibling-reader work, browsing, and coordination/status tools. Own current draft is explicitly derived state, not a rules authority. The current-output reread wording could be clearer; see optional recommendation R1.

static_checks.check: Freezer isolation from administrative benchmark material
static_checks.finding: The freezer reads administrative key and scope material to check counts/IDs and record hashes. Those contents are not interpolated into reader prompt text. The question JSON is copied unchanged. Its actual contents were prohibited to this reviewer and were not inspected, so absence of routing or other content inside that external file is not independently established here.

The freezer asserts the embedded extractor string hashes to its declared digest and that digest equals the audited extractor file hash. No extractor rewrite appears in the inspected freezer. The inspected extractor is generic Markdown structure/range handling without game facts, question maps, source-specific offsets, or scenario logic. Its current exact hash is recorded among inputs; the freezer was not executed.

Both prompts are generated from one shared literal protocol with identical frozen input paths and only the output filename varying. The freezer asserts the output-path-normalized prompts are equal. Independent literal formatting confirmed this property. The embedded protocol exactly equals the standalone template, including its SHA-256.

The protocol requires given data and evaluated comparisons/arithmetic/choices/final outcome for actual cases; a threshold or unevaluated general condition does not suffice. It preserves conditional outcomes when relevant givens are absent and prohibits inventing changed givens.

For lookups, exact operative source text can supply the checked result without an unnecessary additional paraphrase. Governing relevance and completeness must be checked separately from structural extraction validity.

The protocol subjects every substantive field to factual checking, including repeated fields, result, answer, source relevance, and concrete case decisions. Confidence/support labels and structural bookkeeping do not excuse factual errors. Provenance declares the whole-entry rubric unchanged. The actual grader and any historical comparison were outside permitted inputs, so enforcement or historical rubric identity is not independently verified.

At-most-eight-question sequential batches, owned progress storage, no placeholder entries, complete substantive coverage of all IDs before completion, and source-only continuation without factual feedback are explicit. The text distinguishes unfinished work from absent rules. Finite runtime and scheduling cannot be proven statically; clarify own-state reload and partial-pause wording as recommended.

optional_recommendations.topic: Explicit permission for own current-run state reload
optional_recommendations.reason: Keep your current draft in persistent tool memory or your own current work product can reasonably permit resuming from the assigned output, but Use no other files or previous-run outputs can be read more restrictively. Clarify same-reader current-run state versus external game-data authority, especially after a real pause.
optional_recommendations.generic_suggested_text: You may reread only your assigned output for this same reader and this same run as derived progress state. It is not a third external game-data input or a rules authority. Revalidate its substantive claims against the frozen guide and literal questions. Do not read another reader output or any previous run, key, grade, or factual feedback.

optional_recommendations.topic: Separate truthful pause report from completion reply
optional_recommendations.reason: The explicit instruction to save and report partial progress at a real per-turn limit sits beside a final-reply instruction limited to completion. This is manageable but can be made unambiguous without adding factual feedback or answer hints.
optional_recommendations.generic_suggested_text: At a real per-turn limit, save truthful partial progress and report only its path and completed count, clearly marked incomplete; resume the same task from those two frozen inputs and your own current-run state without factual feedback. Claim completion only when all actual IDs have substantive answers.

optional_recommendations.topic: Bind future protocol metadata to the actual generated literal
optional_recommendations.reason: The inspected template and embedded protocol match exactly. The freezer records the external template hash but has no explicit assertion connecting that file to the embedded literal, so future divergence could make the metadata misleading. This is prospective hardening, not a present mismatch.
optional_recommendations.generic_suggested_text: Before generating prompts, assert the protocol literal equals the standalone template, or load one authoritative protocol template and record its hash.

feasibility_limits: Static review establishes instructions and code paths, not actual reader completion, factual accuracy, or sufficient runtime.

Extractor validation proves literal structure/ranges; semantic governing relevance and inclusion of introductory definitions, legends, exceptions, or separately located rules remain reader obligations. The protocol explicitly retains those obligations.
No dispatch implementation was among permitted inputs. NEW status, actual model/effort/fork settings, initial isolation, and later continuation messages cannot be verified from this freezer alone.

Prior freezer, prior audited history, grader implementation, guide, questions, keys, source reports, reader outputs, and observed grades were not read. Historical assertions in provenance are reported as declarations where no permitted comparison exists.
no_game_data_encountered_assertion: No substantive game rules, guide content, literal questions, answer keys, required facts, scenario answers, reader outputs, grades, or coverage/source reports were encountered. Only administrative paths/names and generic method/code were read.

requested_reviewer_configuration.runtime_self_attestation: Configuration requested by parent; not independently inferable from inspected files.
